schema_note: Matches PlayForge's own convention from src/model: all sizes in YARDS, x = 0 at the ball and positive right, y = 0 at the line of scrimmage and positive downfield. Offensive players sit at negative y; off the ball is y = -1. No unit conversion is needed on import. Spots are jobs, not players: Y is the TE and always goes to the strength, Z is the strong receiver, X is the weak receiver, H is the halfback, F is the primary adjuster.
source: 2019 Green Bay Packers offensive playbook (LaFleur), pages 13-24

constants_used.comment: Check these against src/model constants before importing. If PlayForge already defines an OL spacing or a default receiver split, use its value instead of mine.

confidence_legend.derived: Position computed from a rule the playbook states in words.
confidence_legend.needs-review: Name, personnel and family are certain. Position is a reasonable starting shape only; the book shows it as a diagram and never states it in text.
